widgets_values: Under the cold glow of a full moon, middle camera shot of the female scientist sprints down a narrow dirt path through a fog-choked forest, her lab coat flapping wildly behind her as she clutches a glowing tablet emitting emergency data streams. Behind her, a horde of zombie scientists in tattered white coats lurch forward, mouths open in silent screams, arms outstretched. Holographic targeting reticles flash across tree trunks as if she’s being tracked by some unseen system. The camera whips around her in a shaky handheld style, capturing her terrified expression and the first few zombies lunging just meters away — leaves kick up under her feet, and the sound of snapping twigs and guttural moans fills the air.

Next Scene: The camera side view follow the female scientist, she ducks under a fallen branch, skids sideways through wet moss, then vaults a log without breaking stride. The camera spins around her mid-leap, then drops to ground level as she lands — zombies crashing through brush behind her, arms clawing air. Every frame pulses with speed; the forest blurs into streaks of blue and black.

Next Scene: Camera close up face to the female scientist, she zigzags between gnarled trees, shoulders hunched, eyes locked ahead. Camera tracks from behind, then whips to her side as she nearly collides with a trunk — she twists at the last second, boots sliding on damp earth. A zombie lunges — she swerves, barely avoiding its grasp, and the camera jolts violently, mimicking her near-miss.

Next Scene: Camera close up to the female scientist, She charges onto a crumbling wooden bridge — planks crack underfoot as she races across. Behind her, zombies follow, but the bridge collapses mid-stride. She leaps the final gap, landing hard on dirt, rolling forward. Camera follows in slow-mo for the jump, then snaps back to real-time as she scrambles up and keeps running — no pause, no look back.

Next Scene: The forest seems to warp — trees blur, shadows flicker unnaturally. She doesn’t stop, doesn’t question — just pushes harder, sprinting through the distortion like water. Camera swirls dizzyingly around her, then stabilizes as she bursts into a clearing lit by eerie glowing mushrooms. One zombie emerges — she dives under its arm, rolls, and sprints onward.

Next Scene: Camera close up to the female scientist, A distant bunker door glows green ahead — she throws herself forward, sliding under the closing metal slab just as it seals shut. Camera follows her full dive in slow-motion, then cuts to a tight shot of her gasping against the wall inside. Outside, muffled thuds echo… but she’s still moving — already pushing up, ready to run again. The camera stays glued to her — no rest, no relief.
